metrics.label: Period order return rate (L7)

numerator.description: Distinct orders with a return submitted in the window, excluding rejected and deleted returns
numerator.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_EXTERNAL_ID) where CREATED_AT is in the America/New_York window and STATUS is not rejected or deleted

denominator.description: Distinct orders placed in the same America/New_York window, excluding replacement types, test tags, voided, and cancelled
denominator.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT SHOP_ORDER_ID). Order-date column is OS_DT; the filter converts CREATED_AT from UTC to America/New_York

metrics.date_basis: Return CREATED_AT converted to America/New_York; order OS_DT. Default until the open choices are settled. Not a cohort rate: a return in the window can belong to an order placed earlier, so the ratio can exceed 100%. Order-date column is OS_DT (the UTC date of order CREATED_AT); both sides use America/New_York. All channels: OS_ALL_ORDERS has no sales-channel column. Denominator excludes replacement orders whose id is a Redo EXCHANGE_ORDER_EXTERNAL_ID, test and test-order tags, and voided or cancelled orders. OS_ORDER_STATUS redo_exchange and loop_exchange are not exclusion rules. Numerator excludes rejected and deleted returns.
metrics.maturity: L7: 7 complete America/New_York days ending before today. Not a maturity horizon.
metrics.filter_note: Default: SHOP_ORDER_ID is not a Redo EXCHANGE_ORDER_EXTERNAL_ID; tag is not exactly test or test order; not voided; ORDER_CANCELLED_AT is null; return STATUS is not rejected or deleted. OS_ORDER_STATUS redo_exchange and loop_exchange are not exclusions. No sales-channel column, so this is all channels. Comparison figures are not shown in Slack.
metrics.enrichment: The post-purchase aggregate is not used and does not replace Redo outcomes.
metrics.freshness: Queried when /returns runs. Not a stored snapshot.
metrics.evidence: Raw return count and unmatched returns for the default. Comparison counts: numerator including rejected and deleted, denominator including replacement and test orders, and denominator including voided and cancelled orders.

scale.note: Percent of the denominator, 0 to 100. Computed once from summed counts.

metrics.label: Support error rate, Storefront / UX tags (L7)

numerator.description: Distinct conversations carrying a Storefront / UX tag (Issue taxonomy)
numerator.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT ID) where PARSE_JSON(TAGS) holds a UUID of: storefront-experience, web_issues

denominator.description: All conversations created in the window

metrics.date_basis: Conversation CREATED_AT, complete America/New_York days bound with their UTC offsets; the same windows as the period order return rate. _FIVETRAN_DELETED = FALSE.
metrics.maturity: L7: 7 complete America/New_York days ending before today. Not a maturity horizon.
metrics.filter_note: Instances are provisional until a live reconciliation exists. Error group is Storefront / UX (scout.taxonomy.issue_tags.ERROR_RATE_GROUP), a provisional default until the error sub-category is chosen. Tag names resolve to UUIDs through TAG_ID_TO_NAME; 9 legacy taxonomy names in the group have no UUID and match no ticket. All channels.
metrics.freshness: Queried when /errors runs. Not a stored snapshot.
metrics.evidence: Error group, tag names matched, and tag names with no UUID.

scale.note: Percent of the denominator, 0 to 100. Computed once from summed counts.
